item.title: Lala is again a tropical storm, sending drenching rain and winds across the Hawaiian islands
item.description: Hurricane Lala has weakened to a tropical storm after skirting Hawaii without making landfall, but it’s not done punishing the Big Island with hurricane-force gusts.
